name: bridge-it
description: Bridge It! physics bridge-building puzzle game

scripts.build:crazygames: tsc && vite build --mode crazygames && node scripts/size-check.mjs dist-crazygames
scripts.build:poki: tsc && vite build --mode poki && node scripts/size-check.mjs dist-poki
scripts.flavours: npm run build:crazygames && npm run build:poki && node scripts/flavour-check.mjs
scripts.check: tsc && vitest run && vite build && node scripts/size-check.mjs
scripts.app:sync: npm run build && cap sync && node scripts/app-check.mjs
scripts.app:android: npm run app:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
